name: Twenty
description: Twenty is the #1 open-source CRM — a modern, powerful, and affordable platform to manage your customer relationships. Built on PostgreSQL with a NestJS backend and React frontend, it offers customizable objects and fields, Kanban and table views, workflow automation, email/calendar sync, and a powerful API. Self-hosted via Docker Compose for full data ownership.

notes.text: On first access, complete the setup wizard to create your admin account.
This container runs Twenty via Docker Compose (privileged LXC required).
